description: View the Eiffel Tower from the north, looking south. Tests heading=180 with lookAt. Complements evals 003 (south) and 013 (east) for full directional coverage.
name: archive-eiffel-tower-from-north
notes: Imported from optimization/scenarios/cesiumjs-camera/eval-014. Expected source/runtime contracts are scenario-authored; actual values are observed from the archived baseline generated JS and browser artifacts.

expected_behaviors: Heading ~180 degrees (facing south = camera is north of target)
Adds a visible tall Eiffel Tower surrogate because basemap labels alone are not enough
preflight.visual_expectations: The Eiffel Tower area from the north, looking south. A tall gold tower surrogate should be centered and fully visible, with the Champ de Mars and Ecole Militaire behind it. The visual assessment uses a four-shot cardinal panorama (north, east, south, west) from the settled viewer state; the subject should remain understandable across the panorama, and grading considers all screenshots together.

prompt: Use lookAt to view the Eiffel Tower (48.8584 N, 2.2945 E) from the north, looking south toward it. Position the camera at 1000 meters distance with a 25-degree downward angle. I want to see the tower with the Champ de Mars behind it stretching to the south. Because public OSM tiles do not contain inspectable 3D Eiffel Tower geometry, add a tall gold Eiffel Tower surrogate at the coordinates, such as a 300 m cylinder/polyline mast with a clear label, and frame that surrogate as the subject.
